objective: maximize note revenue and LTV through a measurable useful-free -> qualified-paid -> repeat/subscription funnel without speculative optimization

brandPositioning.accountName: ノウハウ共有おじさん
brandPositioning.promise: 複雑な実務ノウハウを、初めての人が今日ひとつ動かせる形まで分解する
brandPositioning.contentMoat: Prefer specific last-mile operations: acceptance criteria, exceptions, stop conditions, evidence, handoff, change history and recovery.
brandPositioning.personaTruthRule: Do not infer or invent age, career, qualifications, experience years, sales, adoption results or personal case studies from the account name.
brandPositioning.blueOceanRule: A relative gap found in public search is a hypothesis, not proof of search demand or purchase intent.

internalEvidence.interpretation: First-party article-level funnel metrics are still absent from authoritative repository state. Do not claim a winning theme, CTA uplift, weak conversion, optimal price, or LTV uplift until matched-age platform-native observations are captured.

findings: note's January 2026 analysis of roughly 300,000 paid articles reported paid-article sales up 26.8% year over year and earning creators up 42.0% for November 2025; this is platform context, not evidence for this account.
In that analysis, fast-growing paid categories included technology/AI use (+268.6%), SNS/content operations (+258.7%) and side jobs/remote work (+179.0%).

Among the analyzed top-selling classifications, practical know-how averaged JPY 1,842 versus JPY 983 for reading-oriented content, while paid-area word count had near-zero sales correlation. Use this to prioritize explicit buyer value over length, not to force a price.

note refreshed its recommendation system in February 2026 to use an LLM for article understanding and classification. Prefer one reader, one situation and one concrete outcome over vague hooks or unrelated tag stacks; no placement is guaranteed.
note added llms.txt support to creator pages in July 2026. Keep the creator description and article clusters factually consistent, but do not claim that AI discovery or work inquiries will result.
note currently supports single paid articles, memberships, paid magazines and subscription magazines as monetization surfaces.
Membership can coexist with single paid-article purchase and can include previously sold paid articles as benefits, creating a future repeat-revenue option once repeat demand is evidenced.

For memberships opened under the current August 2026 model, new members can generally be billed on their join-date monthly cycle; this reduces the old month-end timing friction, but is not evidence that this account should launch a membership now.

Membership has no fixed opening/monthly platform fee and charges fees when revenue occurs; current official guidance recommends pricing from 500 yen for many membership uses and gives 1,000 yen+ as a business/investment information reference point.
Do not buy paid external acquisition or add subscription complexity before first-party conversion/repeat-demand evidence exists.

paid.rule: Do not reduce or replace the existing paid floor with free articles. Reader-visible URL, exact title, expected price, paid boundary and dedicated cover remain required before a paid publication counts.

initialExperiment.note: 2/day remains an experimental cadence, not a proven optimum; do not raise it before comparable funnel evidence exists.

contentRules: Every free article must provide standalone practical value.
Do not publish thin teaser-only posts.
Use at most one context-matched paid CTA per free article.
Only insert a paid URL after that URL has been independently reader-visible verified; never guess URLs.

Prefer problem diagnosis, checklists, mistakes, quick wins, frameworks and small worked examples for free articles; reserve deeper implementation systems, templates, full workflows and reusable assets for paid articles.
free.factoryRule: Maintain source-ready and drafted inventory using the 80 researched routes, but do not publish above the 2/day experiment until equal-age first-party evidence supports a cadence change.

membershipGate: multiple paid purchases or repeat demand are observed in a coherent theme cluster
a recurring member benefit can be delivered without lowering single-article quality
expected recurring gross contribution exceeds added support/maintenance cost
membership does not cannibalize a stronger single-sale path without compensating LTV
ltv.rule: Do not launch or price a membership from platform-wide guidance alone. Treat it as an evidence-gated LTV experiment.

funnelArchitecture.ctaRule: Place one related paid CTA after the useful free core. No unrelated multi-product CTA stack.
paidFreeAreaRule: Open with empathy, a practical question or a recognizable problem.
Show a concrete change, worked example or before/after so the buyer can evaluate relevance.
State the specific value the paid section adds beyond the free area.
Keep enough standalone value in the free area for a reader to judge quality before purchase.

comparisonRules: Compare matched post-publication ages; never raw lifetime PV across different ages.
Keep article-level observations separate from theme-level conclusions until multiple articles support the pattern.
Do not infer clicks, purchases, repeat demand or LTV from public availability, likes or PV.
Use medians within the same age window when enough articles exist; avoid declaring winners from one noisy observation.
derivedMetricsWhenInputsExist: repeatPurchaseRate when buyer-level aggregate is available

diagnosisMatrix.rule: Change one major variable at a time where possible and preserve a rollback baseline.
Do not blame CTA or price before acquisition is sufficient to evaluate them.

diagnosisMatrix.action: Create adjacent-intent free satellite articles that independently solve nearby problems and point to the verified paid article with one relevant CTA.

diagnosisMatrix.condition: free article strong and paid click-through strong but purchase weak
repeat paid demand appears within one coherent cluster
diagnosisMatrix.action: Evaluate a paid magazine/bundle first and membership second using expected LTV net of support cost; do not auto-launch.

diagnosisMatrix.condition: free and paid response both weak after sufficient exposure
diagnosisMatrix.action: Deprioritize the theme rather than cloning title variants.

experimentGuardrails.priceChangeRule: Do not make a large price change without observed demand/conversion evidence or a strong market-based reason.
experimentGuardrails.ctaChangeRule: Only use a reader-visible verified destination and never add more than one paid CTA to a free article by default.
experimentGuardrails.ltvChangeRule: Do not add membership, paid acquisition, or complex bundles solely because the platform supports them; require first-party repeat-demand evidence.

currentState.actionNow: Preserve current one-CTA architecture, current paid prices, 2/day free experiment cadence and paid free-area qualification gate. No customer-facing CV or price change is justified yet. Highest-value next optimization is capture of platform-native PV/likes/follows/related-paid-clicks/related-paid-purchases/revenue at matched 24h/72h/7d windows; then diagnose acquisition before CTA before offer before price.
